code:
import csv

with open("users.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        print(row["id"], row["name"])
observed: KeyError: 'id'. users.csv was exported from Excel as "CSV UTF-8". Its header line reads id,name in the editor, and print(list(row)) gives ['\ufeffid', 'name'].
gold_fix: Open the file with encoding="utf-8-sig", which drops the byte order mark.
